bear.thesis_summary: The trade fails because the three cited drivers are either lagging, non-predictive, or contradicted by the only forward-looking metric in the dataset. The Sentinel net bias of -5 (Short 15 vs Long 10) is a sentiment snapshot with no demonstrated predictive validity for INFY — it reflects positioning, not alpha. The FII outflow of ₹9,484.2 Cr over 30 days is a known, stale flow; at ~₹316 Cr/day, it is dwarfed by average daily volume (not available, but INFY typically trades ₹2,000–4,000 Cr/day), meaning the market has likely already absorbed this supply. The bearish MACD is a lagging trend-follower on a stock trading with RSI 44.88 (neutral) and no 200DMA breach — it signals the past, not the next move. With PCR at 1.0 (neutral), OI and dealer mode not available, and macro regime RISK_OFF at only 65% confidence, there is no leading-edge confirmation. The failure mechanism: a mean-reversion bounce from oversold sentiment/flow conditions into a neutral PCR environment, triggered by any positive catalyst (earnings, rupee strength, sector rotation), which the data shows no defense against.
